verdict.rationale: Qualcomm documents official developer tooling — the AI Engine Direct SDK, Qualcomm AI Hub, and the open-source GenieX toolkit for shipping Gen AI models with a unified NPU/GPU/CPU runtime, plus model conversion (PyTorch/ONNX to LiteRT/ONNX Runtime/Qualcomm AI Runtime) and cloud profiling — which directly support AI-native development on Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme hardware. However all evidence is vendor-sourced with no independent developer corroboration, the core spec/developer pages are unreadable to non-browser fetchers (JS-only shell), and there's no llms.txt/OpenAPI machine-readable interface. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports validating the SDKs, machine-readable API/docs discovery (llms.txt/OpenAPI all 404), and concrete API reference/versioning details.
